_comment: SYNTHETIC. Path: <CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude>/sessions/<pid>.json. Deleted on normal process exit. Optional fields seen in the CLI reader: nameSource(user|peer|derived|collision|auto|hook), formerNames, tmux, logPath, agent, jobId, parkedJobId, spare, bridgeSessionId, waitingFor, state, detail, tempo, needs. This example is a desktop-hosted one; a terminal CLI one would have entrypoint 'cli' (UNVERIFIED value) and no hostSessionId.
